# datadog_integration_coreweave_cloud_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog CoreWeave integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the CoreWeave integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the CoreWeave integration account.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings configured on the CoreWeave integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Optional

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from CoreWeave, keyed by dataflow id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `core_weave_cloud_integration_account_api_token_auth` (Attributes) The API token authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--core_weave_cloud_integration_account_api_token_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--core_weave_cloud_integration_account_api_token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.core_weave_cloud_integration_account_api_token_auth`

Optional:

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Secret CoreWeave API access token used to authenticate with CoreWeave. Values that do not start with `CW-SECRET-` are rejected with a `422` response. Exactly one of `api_token` or `api_token_wo` must be set. Prefer `api_token_wo`, which Terraform 1.11+ keeps out of state; this attribute is stored in Terraform state.
- `api_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret CoreWeave API access token used to authenticate with CoreWeave. Values that do not start with `CW-SECRET-` are rejected with a `422` response. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `api_token_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for api_token_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.
- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `coreweave_api_token`. Defaults to `"coreweave_api_token"`.



<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Optional:

- `account_tags` (List of String) Tags added to all data collected from this CoreWeave account.
- `cluster_filters` (List of String) Tag-filter rules limiting metric collection to matching clusters. Absent when no filters are configured.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Optional:

- `coreweave_cloud_logs` (Attributes) Service logs for CoreWeave-managed components in each CoreWeave region: the CKS control plane (such as `kube-apiserver` and `etcd`), CoreWeave add-on services in the `cw-*` and `kube-system` namespaces, SUNK, and node system logs such as `kubelet` and `containerd`. Logs from your own workloads and Kubernetes audit logs are not collected. Logs are sent with `source:coreweave`, with CoreWeave log labels such as `namespace`, `app`, and `systemd_unit` added as tags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--coreweave_cloud_logs))
- `coreweave_cloud_metrics` (Attributes) Metrics from your CoreWeave organization: CoreWeave service metrics collected through its PromQL-compatible Prometheus endpoint, plus the `coreweave.*` namespaces from CoreWeave products such as Kubernetes, Database, Distributed File Storage, Inference, and Object Storage. Compute metrics (`coreweave.bare_metal`, `coreweave.gpu`, `coreweave.nccl`, and `coreweave.node`) are in Preview. Container metrics are not collected; install the Datadog Agent on your clusters for those. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--coreweave_cloud_metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--coreweave_cloud_logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.coreweave_cloud_logs`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data. Absent when the dataflow has never been configured, in which case the documented default applies.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--coreweave_cloud_metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.coreweave_cloud_metrics`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data. Absent when the dataflow has never been configured, in which case the documented default applies.
